node.statement: Core lemma: assume 0<epsilon<1/2 and write the probability rows of A as a_i=(a_{i1},...,a_{ik}) and those of M as mu_s=(mu_s(1),...,mu_s(n)). Put lambda=sqrt(epsilon/2), C_s={i:a_{is}>1-lambda}, and beta_s=mu_s(C_s^c). Then D_s:=sum_i mu_s(i)(1-a_{is}) <= epsilon/2 for every s, the sets C_s are pairwise disjoint, and beta_s <= epsilon/(2*lambda)=lambda<1.
